cli.ayuda_abrir_editor: also opens the theme editor (the installer uses it when it finishes)
cli.ayuda_demo_segundos: how long to show the clock (0 = until Ctrl+C)
cli.ayuda_ejecutar: shows a theme with real data
cli.ayuda_editor: opens the theme editor without the tray icon
cli.ayuda_desarrollo: doesn't open a window: prints the address for “npm run dev” (Vite, port 5173)
cli.detectar_ninguna: I can't find any supported display connected.
cli.detectar_rev_a_o_b: a Turing / UsbPCMonitor 3,5" display (revision A) or a XuanFang 3,5" (beta): it has the USB of both and no known serial number. Nothing will be sent to it without your confirmation.
cli.detectar_no_compatible: {model}, not supported yet. Nothing will be sent to it.
cli.detectar_segura_beta: {model} (beta: not tested with a real display yet). Recognized by its serial number.
cli.detectar_parece: looks like a {model} (beta), but only by its USB: not certain. Nothing will be sent to it without your confirmation.
cli.ejecutar_ctrl_c: Showing the theme. Ctrl+C to stop.
cli.ejecutar_estadisticas: {seconds} s · {patches} chunks sent · {kbps} KB/s on average · app CPU: {cpu} % of the computer
cli.editor_modo: Editor mode: the display isn't being used right now.
cli.editor_sin_compilar: The editor isn't built: run “npm run build” in editor/.
